questions.question: Verify ab ((a mod m)(b mod m)) (mod m) using a=13, b=7,m=5
questions.solution_html:
• Verification of modular multiplication ((6 marks))
  • LHS: 13×7=91 → 91 mod 5 = 1.
  • RHS: (13 mod 5)=3, (7 mod 5)=2 → 3×2=6 → 6 mod 5 = 1.
  • Verified.
  • Marks: Steps 4 + final 2
questions.source_exam: First Semester MGU-UGP/MGU-BBA/MGU-BCA Honours Examinations November 2025

questions.question: i) Encrypt the message IN THE BOOK using the function f = ( 2p +5) mod
questions.solution_html:
• (i) Affine cipher ((8 marks))
  • Use f(p)=2p+5 mod 26.
  • Convert text → apply function → convert back.
  • Marks: conversion 3 + encryption steps 3 + final text 2
  • (ii) Pseudorandom numbers ((7 marks))
  • xn+1=(4xn+3) mod 4, start x0=3.
  • Generate 10 values.
  • Marks: 5 steps + 2 final sequence
questions.source_exam: First Semester MGU-UGP/MGU-BBA/MGU-BCA Honours Examinations November 2025

questions.question: Solve: 2x - y = 0; x + 3y = 7 using i) Cramers rule ii) Matrix inversion method
